name: 32944-solodecode-30ba3b-tp2
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Public and ungated, already in the local HF cache (~57 GB), so nothing downloads before the first run.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node. SM90, 132 SMs, 50 MB L2, 3.35 TB/s.
parallelism: TP=2, EP=1 (no expert parallelism), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30.5B total / ~3.3B active, bf16 with no quantization_config. 48 decoder layers, every one MoE: 128 routed experts, top-8, expert width 768, no shared expert. 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 40 requests with a 600 s safety cap. One request is resident at a time.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: 512 prompt tokens in, 1024 generated out, both fixed (stdev 0), with `ignore_eos` true and `temperature` 0.0 in `extras.body`, so every request generates exactly 1024 tokens. Seed 42.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on a 30B expert-routed model, one request at a time across two GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. The parser reads line by line and SKIPS indented lines, so a value
# re-flowed onto a second line -- `cuda-graph-bs-decode: [1]` in particular -- is dropped
# silently and the engine starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 2
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
cuda-graph-bs-decode: [1]
stream-interval: 1
random-seed: 42
